name: builder-kit
description: An explicitly invoked, token-efficient harness for planning, implementing, and reviewing agent-driven software. It helps technical and non-technical users produce sustainable code through approval-gated specifications, pragmatic repository-aware standards, conditional expert lenses, safe Git workflows, and evidence-backed verification.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver sustainable agent-built software safely.
interface.longDescription: An explicitly invoked, specification-driven development harness for technical and non-technical users. Builder Kit routes only relevant standards and expert lenses, protects unrelated work, enforces approval boundaries for non-trivial changes, and verifies implementation with production-minded engineering guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Use $builder-kit to plan and build this feature safely
Use $start-new-app to design a sustainable new application
